rachel (docs): opened a compact PR to update SDK snippets for streaming, pagination, and retries. main goals: idiomatic names per language, show minimal retry/backoff, add a 1-iteration CI harness, and fix a dead retry link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/778

tom (eng): I'll review Python + TS. confirmation: behavior unchanged, just example edits?

leo (sdk): taking Go. naming check: stream_generate for py; streamGenerate for ts/go?

rachel (docs): yes, keep idiomatic names. no API changes. snippets below are intentionally minimal for CI runs.

rachel (docs): ```python
# python streaming + retry (one-iteration)
from redwood import Client
import asyncio
client = Client()
async def once():
    async for c in client.stream_generate("Summarize:", max_tokens=64, retry_policy={"backoff":"exp","max_retries":2}):
        print(c.text); break
asyncio.run(once())
```

rachel (docs): ```ts
// ts streaming minimal
const s = client.streamGenerate({ prompt: 'Summarize:', maxTokens: 64 });
for await (const c of s) { console.log(c.text); break }
// note: very short outputs may be coalesced by transport
```

rachel (docs): ```go
// go pagination minimal
ctx := context.Background()
it := client.ListEmbeddings(ctx, &redwood.ListEmbeddingsRequest{PageSize:10})
if it.Next() { _ = it.Item() }
if err := it.Err(); err!=nil { /* report */ }
// next_cursor empty at EOF
```
